provenance: real production failure, run 5a52f0aa on the deployed instance (2026-08-15): claude-sonnet-4.5 via OpenRouter wrapped the plan in a markdown fence; json.loads failed -> failure:env. Content here is the actual payload, trimmed. Extended 2026-08-28 with `also_rejects`, closing the `parse_plan` half of T-M40-2-6 (P1). The only structural check was `isinstance(steps, list)`, so `[null]` and `["extract WebArea"]` were plans as far as every layer below was concerned; the step loop then read `step["action"]` off a string and a bare TypeError left `run_task` with no status and no failure class — `server.py:_execute` caught it into `failure:env` so a DEPLOYED run reported something, while an eval-adapter caller got the raw exception. Both directions are graded here on purpose: an accept-only case stays green under a parser that accepts everything, which is what this one was. The fourth payload is a well-formed step followed by a bad one, because `steps[0]` being fine is exactly how this survives a spot check. Watched red before the guard: all four parsed.
